title: API Client HTTPS over the shared SocketProvider carrier boundary
summary: API Client keeps HTTP/TLS authority while Socket Intention dynamically selects a raw SocketProvider stream for each request.
invariants: ApiHttpsTransport owns HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, redirects, TLS identity, SNI and ALPN.
SocketProvider owns native carrier acquisition and retains the exact selected SocketAddress object.
ApiSocketProviderConnector does not choose TCP, XTP, Unix or any other socket family.
The route resolver must supply the exact current SocketAddress selected by lower routing/Intention authority.
RxSock remains the default API Client carrier when no ApiSocketConnector is injected.
Provider-backed TLS fails closed unless the native endpoint exposes bounded SELECT, PUMP or POLL progress/readiness.
The adapter creates an architectural HTTPS-over-XTP route but does not constitute live HTTPS-over-XTP qualification.
ApiSocketIntentionRouteResolver performs fresh negotiation on every resolve and does not cache a startup route.
API Client route requirements remain exact ooRexx objects in negotiation metadata; they are not converted into socket-family policy.
Lower carrier negotiation requires a stream but not a secure socket because API Client TLS runs above it; TLS SocketProvider is excluded from the default raw carrier schemes.

provenance.claim: Adds optional ApiSocketConnector acquisition while retaining ApiRxSockConnector as the default.
Maps a resolved SocketAddress to SocketProvider~streamSenderAt and exposes the minimal carrier contract consumed by API Client TLS.
Provides streamSenderAt plus stream read/write/close and provider-native PUMP/POLL delegation.
dev2 adds ApiSocketIntentionRouteResolver with fresh per-request socket.negotiation/0.1 selection and exact ApiRouteRequirement preservation.

open: Run carrier and Socket Intention resolver deterministic suites under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 from current main.
Qualify an exact XTP dev33 selected sender/stream with bounded provider-native PUMP/POLL readiness.
Run live API Client HTTPS over that XTP carrier before making any HTTPS-over-XTP claim.

current_xtp_context.protection: per-service sessions/messages/streams; LDAP Identity Directory + Secret Broker optional key source
